description: This Java class 'ImageManagementHelper' provides a static method to retrieve the internal URL of an image associated with a product, querying the database for default or other approved images.

classes.name: ImageManagementHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for image URL retrieval related to product images.

methods.name: getInternalImageUrl
methods.description: Retrieves the internal URL of a product's image, prioritizing default images and falling back to other approved images.
